integrity: All claims concern the seven-dimensional noncommutative unital algebra with distinct xy and yx, and all finite-field orders. Computation corroborates a general symbolic proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two noncommuting generators truncated at word length three; derivation endomorphism ranks, not conjugacy classes or outer-derivation ranks. Earlier equivalent enumerations under different terminology remain a bibliographic risk. Finite enumerations do not prove the general formula.
title: Derivation-rank spectra of the free two-loop algebra truncated at length three
